prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize muscle recovery and strength performance with optimized protein timing around weightlifting training
prompt_inputs.restrictions: No shellfish or tree nuts due to allergies

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers a full 24-hour day with 4-5 meals
Minimum 2.0g protein per kg bodyweight (170g total) distributed across meals with emphasis pre/post-workout
Includes specific meal timing recommendations around training session
Respects all dietary restrictions (no shellfish or tree nuts)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) needing protein-focused meals with strategic nutrient timing for muscle recovery and performance

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize energy and recovery for early morning swimming training (5:30 AM session, 90 minutes) with afternoon practice
prompt_inputs.restrictions: No shellfish, prefers quick-prep meals due to limited time before training

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans one full day with at least 4 eating occasions strategically timed around swimming sessions
Pre-dawn meal (before 5:30 AM training) is light and easily digestible; post-training meal includes protein and carbs for recovery
All meals and snacks require minimal preparation time (under 15 minutes each) and avoid shellfish
Caloric intake and macronutrient distribution are appropriate for a 72 kg swimmer with dual training sessions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific constraint scenario (swimmer with early morning training) requiring practical meal timing that accommodates pool sessions and limited preparation time

prompt_inputs.goal: Prepare for marathon race in 2 weeks with optimal energy and recovery

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and strategic pre/post-workout snacks
Provides approximately 3,200-3,500 calories with carbohydrates comprising 60-65% of total intake
Includes timing recommendations around training (e.g., pre-workout and post-workout meals)
All meals and snacks align with vegetarian and dairy-free restrictions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring calorie-dense, carbohydrate-rich meals with specific timing around training windows
